prompt: In 1946, Cold War begins. USA was much larger : Also having Canada, liberty colonies in Africa, and parts of Mexico. Also richer and technologically advanced, and USA also had Greenland and Iceland, and Philippines, Puerto Rico, Guam, and Cuba as a state
judge_reasoning: All candidates stay within speculative alt-history, but Candidate 1 is the only one that meaningfully touches nearly every element of the prompt (Canada/parts of Mexico, African “liberty colonies,” Greenland/Iceland, and multiple Pacific/Caribbean territories). Candidate 4 covers Greenland/Iceland and Pacific territory fairly well but largely omits the North America/Africa portions and several named territories (e.g., Philippines, Puerto Rico, Cuba). Candidate 3 focuses mostly on the African colonial angle and leaves most other regions unaddressed, while Candidate 2 largely reframes into a “unified North American government” narrative centered on Canada and Mexico rather than covering the rest of the listed scenario details.
